head_coach.name: Mohamed Ouahbi
head_coach.play_style_summary: Emphasizes a highly disciplined, high-pressing defensive structure combined with quick combination plays and creative, fluid attacking transitions designed to exploit technical qualities in advanced areas.

key_players.name: Achraf Hakimi
key_players.performance_stats: The team's captain and defensive anchor; vital for his physical dominance, elite transition speed, and world-class overlapping runs from the flank.

key_players.name: Ayyoub Bouaddi
key_players.performance_stats: A highly rated young prodigy from Lille who chose to represent Morocco; renowned for his composed ball progression and maturity in structural midfield play.

key_players.name: Brahim Díaz
key_players.performance_stats: Real Madrid playmaker who serves as the chief creative force between the lines, bringing exceptional dribbling, agility, and offensive output.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Suffered a muscle injury during a training session with Sunderland, creating major uncertainty for his World Cup availability.
